statements.text: The study enrolled 23 HIV controllers, 8 ART-suppressed subjects, and 10 HIV-1-negative individuals.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: HICs (n = 23), antiretroviral (ART)-suppressed subjects (n = 8), and HIV-1-negative (NEG) individuals (n = 10)
statements.note: The sample sizes for the three groups are stated directly.

statements.text: ERVK-6 RNA expression in HIV controllers was significantly higher than in both the ART and HIV-negative control groups.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: ERVK-6 RNA expression in PBMCs from HICs was significantly downregulated compared with that in both the ART and NEG control groups
statements.note: The abstract reports ERVK-6 was downregulated in HICs, not higher.

statements.text: p21 and MCPIP1 expression levels were higher in HIV controllers than in ART-suppressed subjects.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: ERVK-6 RNA levels in PBMCs across all groups were negatively correlated with the expression levels of p21 and MCPIP1
statements.note: A correlation is reported, but the abstract never compares p21/MCPIP1 levels between the groups.

statements.text: ERVK-6 RNA levels across all groups were inversely related to p21 and MCPIP1 expression.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: ERVK-6 RNA levels in PBMCs across all groups were negatively correlated with the expression levels of p21 and MCPIP1
statements.note: A negative correlation with p21 and MCPIP1 is reported directly.

statements.text: Non-negative matrix factorization resolved ten mutational signatures spanning the major DSB repair pathways.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: Analysis using NMF revealed four mutational signatures
statements.note: The abstract reports four signatures, not ten.

statements.text: CRISPR knockouts covered 307 known and 459 candidate DSB repair genes in mouse embryonic stem cells.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: CRISPR knockouts of 307 known and 459 candidate DSB repair genes
statements.note: These gene counts are stated directly.

statements.text: The pipeline was also applied to human tumour samples to validate the inferred gene functions.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: We generated mutational spectra for mouse embryonic stem (mES) cells at three target sites
statements.note: Only mouse ES cell experiments are described; no application to human tumour samples is mentioned.

statements.text: NMF resolved four mutational signatures linked to HDR, MMEJ, and the initiation and ligation parts of NHEJ.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: NMF revealed four mutational signatures associated with homology-directed repair (HDR), microhomology-mediated end-joining (MMEJ), and the initiation and ligation components of non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ)
statements.note: The four signatures and their pathway assignments are stated directly.

statements.text: Dogs with a Cancer Signal Detected result after surgery were 1.95 times as likely to recur within six months as those without.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: patients with Cancer Signal Detected results at that visit were 1.95-times as likely to have clinical recurrence within 6 months compared to patients with Cancer Signal Not Detected results
statements.note: The 1.95-fold recurrence likelihood is stated directly.

statements.text: The liquid biopsy test detected cancer signals earlier than diagnostic imaging in these dogs.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: Next-generation sequencing-based liquid biopsy is a non-invasive tool for cancer monitoring in dogs that can be used as an adjunct to current standard-of-care clinical assessment methods
statements.note: The test is called an adjunct to standard-of-care, but its timing is never compared against imaging.

statements.text: Among recurrent dogs with longitudinal samples, 73% had a cancer signal detected before or at the time of clinical recurrence.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: 73% (8/11; 95% CI: 39 – 93%) of patients had Cancer Signal Detected in blood prior to or concomitant with clinical recurrence
statements.note: The 73% (8/11) figure is reported directly.

statements.text: Where molecular recurrence preceded clinical recurrence, the median lead time was only about 28 days.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: the median lead time was 168 days (range: 47 – 238)
statements.note: The reported median lead time was 168 days, not about 28 days.

statements.text: Patients received neoadjuvant chemotherapy guided by their ctDNA results.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: Preoperative ctDNA demonstrates promise as a biomarker for selecting patients to undergo neoadjuvant chemotherapy prior to nephroureterectomy
statements.note: ctDNA is proposed for selecting NAC candidates, but no patient is reported to have received NAC.

statements.text: Combining at least two molecular alterations with a copy number burden score above 6.5 gave 79% sensitivity and 94% specificity for MI/NOC disease.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: a plasma copy number burden score >6.5 achieved a sensitivity of 79% and specificity of 94% in predicting MI/NOC UTUC
statements.note: These sensitivity and specificity values are stated directly.

statements.text: Preoperative ctDNA positivity showed no significant association with progression-free or overall survival.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: the presence of ctDNA was strongly prognostic for progression-free survival (1-yr PFS 69% vs. 100%, p<0.01) and overall survival (1-yr OS 56% vs. 100%, p<0.02)
statements.note: ctDNA was strongly prognostic for both PFS and OS, contradicting no association.

statements.text: ctDNA variants were detected in 70% (21 of 30) of enrolled patients.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: At least one ctDNA variant was detected from 21/30 (70%) patients
statements.note: The 21/30 (70%) detection rate is stated directly.

statements.text: At the bulk level LGALS2 tracked with better survival while LGALS3 marked worse prognosis.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: LGALS2 was associated with favorable survival, while LGALS3 predicted poor prognosis
statements.note: The opposing prognostic associations of LGALS2 and LGALS3 are stated directly.

statements.text: Pathological complete response to chemo-immunotherapy was associated with lower LGALS3 and higher LGALS2.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy was associated with higher LGALS3 and lower LGALS2, LGALS8, and LGALS9
statements.note: The abstract reports higher LGALS3 and lower LGALS2 with pCR, the opposite of this statement.

statements.text: Knockdown of LGALS3 in TNBC cell lines reduced tumour growth.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: highlighting the clinical and translational relevance of galectins as candidate biomarkers and hypothesis-generating molecules for future mechanistic studies
statements.note: The work is descriptive and names mechanistic work as future; no galectin knockdown is reported.

statements.text: The analysis combined bulk FUSCC (465 patients) and TCGA (161 patients) cohorts with single-cell data from 26 treatment-naive patients.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: FUSCC (n = 465) and TCGA (n = 161) TNBC cohorts with single-cell RNA sequencing data from 26 treatment-naïve patients
statements.note: The cohort sizes are stated directly.

statements.text: High DNA fragmentation was associated with longer progression-free and overall survival.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: High fragmentation similarly correlated with reduced PFS (4.7 vs. 10.7 months; p<0.001) and OS (13.1 vs. 22.3 months; p<0.001)
statements.note: High fragmentation correlated with reduced, not longer, PFS and OS.

statements.text: Recurrent copy number gains were seen on chromosome arms 1q and 8q.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Frequent CNA gains were observed in chromosomal arms 1q and 8q
statements.note: The 1q and 8q gains are stated directly.

statements.text: Tumour fraction measurement outperformed serum AFP for predicting survival.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: High AFP levels, advanced BCLC stage, and larger tumours correlated with elevated TF
statements.note: AFP is linked to tumour fraction, but TF is never compared head-to-head with AFP as a predictor.

statements.text: High tumour fraction was tied to a shorter median PFS of 3.0 versus 10.6 months.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: High TF was significantly associated with shorter median PFS (3.0 vs. 10.6 months; p<0.001)
statements.note: The 3.0 versus 10.6 month PFS split is stated directly.

statements.text: The locus-specific TE changes were shown to alter expression of neighbouring protein-coding genes.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: By integrating p53 ChIP peaks with differentially expressed TE transcripts, we identified retroelements directly regulated by p53
statements.note: The pipeline maps p53-regulated TEs but does not examine effects on nearby protein-coding gene expression.

statements.text: In normal IMR90 fibroblasts TEs were mostly activated, while in HCT116 cancer cells they were repressed after p53 activation.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: TEs were predominantly activated in normal IMR90 cells but repressed in HCT116 cancer cells
statements.note: The opposite responses in normal and cancer cells are stated directly.

statements.text: The trend was corroborated across 24 transcriptomes and 10 cistromes.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Analysis of 24 transcriptomes and 10 cistromes further confirmed this trend
statements.note: These dataset counts are stated directly.

statements.text: In cancer cells, p53 activation broadly upregulated Alu and LINE elements.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: cancer cells exhibited selective repression of Alu and LINE elements, with weaker effects on endogenous retroviruses
statements.note: Cancer cells selectively repressed Alu and LINE elements rather than upregulating them.

statements.text: The haploid assembly is 11.78 Mb across 17 contigs with 2705 protein-coding genes.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: The haploid genome spans 11.78 Mb in 17 contigs and contains 2705 protein-coding genes
statements.note: These assembly statistics are stated directly.

statements.text: The broad host range of A. algerae is driven by its high transposable-element content.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: obligate intracellular microsporidian parasite with an unusually broad host range and a genome enriched in transposable elements (TEs)
statements.note: Broad host range and TE enrichment are both noted, but no causal link between them is claimed.

statements.text: Transposable elements make up roughly 60% of the genome.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: TEs occupy about 24% of the genome and are represented by 4972 copies distributed across 260 families
statements.note: TEs occupy about 24% of the genome, not roughly 60%.

statements.text: Merlin DNA transposons and Ty3 LTR retrotransposons were the most abundant TEs.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Merlin DNA transposons and Ty3 LTR retrotransposons are the most abundant
statements.note: These two classes are named as the most abundant directly.

statements.text: Clustering of copper homeostasis genes defined two prognostic molecular subgroups.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: We then identified three molecular subgroups of copper homeostasis-related genes linked to prognosis
statements.note: The abstract reports three molecular subgroups, not two.

statements.text: The authors assessed somatic mutation and copy number variation rates across 51 copper homeostasis-related genes.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: we determined the rate of somatic mutations and copy number variations (CNVs) of 51 copper homeostasis-related genes
statements.note: The 51-gene analysis is stated directly.

statements.text: The four-gene model predicted response to temozolomide chemotherapy in glioma patients.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: these biomarkers are useful for diagnostic and prognostic purposes and could be used to guide our understanding of the progression of and treatment of glioma tumorigenesis
statements.note: Prognostic and diagnostic value is claimed, but no test of chemotherapy response prediction is reported.

statements.text: A LASSO model of four cuproptosis genes showed strong prognostic ability in the CGGA cohort.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: This model was found to have strong prognostic ability in the CGGA cohort (P<0.05)
statements.note: The LASSO model's prognostic performance in CGGA is stated directly.

statements.text: BAP1 inactivating mutations occur in about 45% of primary and around 85% of metastatic uveal melanomas.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: approximately 45% of primary and ∼85% of metastatic uveal melanoma (UM) cases
statements.note: These mutation frequencies are stated directly.

statements.text: Senolytic treatment improved survival in patients with BAP1-mutant uveal melanoma.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: suggest that BAP1 -mutant tumors may benefit from senolytics treatment
statements.note: Benefit is proposed for future treatment; no patient survival outcome was measured.

statements.text: Loss of BAP1 raised senescence markers such as p16 and p21 and sensitized cells to the senolytics dasatinib and quercetin.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: BAP1 knockdown, alone or in combination with ionizing radiation, sensitized UM cells to senolytic agents, dasatinib and quercetin
statements.note: BAP1 loss raising senescence hallmarks and sensitizing cells to these senolytics is stated directly.

statements.text: BAP1 loss reduced senescence markers, lowering p16 and p21 and increasing lamin B1.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: BAP1 loss promotes senescence hallmarks including upregulated p16, p21, and phospho-ATM proteins, increased β-gal positive cells, accumulated γH2AX foci, depleted lamin B1
statements.note: BAP1 loss raised p16 and p21 and depleted lamin B1, the opposite of this statement.

statements.text: The four-gene signature comprised NOP10, UTP20, SHQ1 and PIH1D2.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: We established a four-gene RBRGs signature (NOP10, UTP20, SHQ1, and PIH1D2)
statements.note: The four genes making up the signature are listed directly.

statements.text: Knockdown of UTP20 increased glioma cell proliferation and invasion in vitro.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: UTP20 knockdown significantly suppressed glioma cell proliferation and invasion in vitro
statements.note: UTP20 knockdown suppressed, not increased, proliferation and invasion.

statements.text: A nomogram including the RBRGs score reached a C-index of 0.841.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: A nomogram incorporating the RBRGs score demonstrated excellent predictive performance (C-index = 0.841)
statements.note: The C-index of 0.841 is stated directly.

statements.text: The RBRGs signature was also validated in a cohort of non-glioma brain tumours.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: validating its prognostic value in independent cohorts
statements.note: Validation cohorts were glioma; no non-glioma tumour type is mentioned.

statements.text: Anticoagulant prophylaxis reduced VTE incidence in patients carrying these somatic mutations.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: inform future efforts to improve clinical risk prediction
statements.note: The study reports associations only and evaluates no anticoagulant intervention.

statements.text: Somatic mutations in CDKN2A, KRAS, PCDH15 and TP53 were each associated with higher rates of VTE.
statements.label: supported
statements.note: All four genes show hazard ratios above 1 for VTE.

statements.text: A high tumour mutational burden of at least 20 mutations/Mb was associated with higher rates of VTE.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: TMB ≥20 mutations/Mb, two DNA mismatch repair signatures (SBS6 and SBS26) and one rare signature of unknown aetiology (SBS19) associated with lower rates of VTE
statements.note: High TMB was associated with lower, not higher, rates of VTE.

statements.text: The analysis drew on paired tumour and germline whole-genome sequencing from 12,507 cancer patients.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: paired tumour and germline whole genome sequence data and electronic health records from 12,507 cancer patients
statements.note: The cohort size and paired sequencing design are stated directly.

statements.text: Overexpression of STXBP5 delayed the onset of cellular senescence.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: STXBP5 overexpression accelerated the onset of senescence
statements.note: STXBP5 overexpression accelerated, not delayed, senescence onset.

statements.text: Deleting STXBP5 lowered progerin expression and delayed senescence.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: STXBP5 deletion suppressed progerin expression, delayed senility, and decreased the expression of senescence-related factors
statements.note: The effects of STXBP5 deletion are stated directly.

statements.text: Reducing STXBP5 improved lifespan in a mouse model of progeria.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: decreasing STXBP5 expression is a potential new therapeutic strategy for treating ageing-related phenotypes in patients with HGPS
statements.note: Reducing STXBP5 is proposed as a strategy, but no animal lifespan experiment is reported.

statements.text: Co-immunoprecipitation showed that STXBP5 binds progerin directly.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: STXBP5 bound directly to progerin
statements.note: Direct binding of STXBP5 to progerin from Co-IP is stated directly.

statements.text: The assembled chromosome measured 2.18 Mb and carried eight genomic islands.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: We obtained a 2.18 Mb, high-quality chromosome and found eight genomic islands
statements.note: The chromosome size and island count are stated directly.

statements.text: The prophage Ph01 carried two virD4 virulence genes within the chromosome.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: prophage Ph01, which was found to be in the chromosome of this strain and included two hyaluronidase ( hyl ) genes
statements.note: Ph01 included two hyaluronidase genes; the virD4 genes were located in a genomic island, not Ph01.

statements.text: In vitro, strain ZHZ 211 was resistant to clarithromycin, enrofloxacin and sulfonamides.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: ZHZ 211 grows faster and is resistant to clarithromycin, enrofloxacin, and sulfonamides
statements.note: The resistance phenotype is stated directly.

statements.text: Strain ZHZ 211 caused more severe disease in horses than other S. zooepidemicus strains.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: ZHZ 211 has more virulence factors, like an iron uptake system, adherence, exoenzymes, and antiphagocytosis
statements.note: More virulence factors were found genomically, but no animal disease-severity comparison was done.

statements.text: Among untreated stage IV patients, those with detectable ctDNA had longer median overall survival than those without.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: median overall survival was 10 months for those with detectable ctDNA (95% CI = 6.9 to 14 months) vs 19 months (95% CI = 13 months to not reached) for those with undetectable ctDNA (P = .1)
statements.note: Detectable ctDNA was linked to shorter (10 vs 19 month) survival, not longer.

statements.text: ctDNA was detected in 75% of stage IV, 38% of stage III and 34% of stage I-II patients.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: 75% stage IV, 38% stage III, 34% stage I-II disease
statements.note: The stage-specific detection rates are stated directly.

statements.text: ctDNA detection predicted response to FOLFIRINOX chemotherapy.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: ctDNA is a promising tool in the detection of somatic variants in pancreas ductal adenocarcinoma
statements.note: No specific chemotherapy regimen or treatment-response analysis is reported.

statements.text: Patients with liver metastases had higher ctDNA detection than those without (82% vs 52%).
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Higher rates of ctDNA detection were observed in patients with liver metastases vs without (82% vs 52%, P < .001)
statements.note: The 82% versus 52% split by liver metastasis is stated directly.

statements.text: Strain d1418m22 was isolated from a bloodstream infection.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: Six reference MRSA strains were isolated from (MRSA-AMRF4 and MRSA-AMRF5) eye infections, (MRSA and MRSA-15) wound pus, (VMRSA-WC071, and VMRSA-WC081) urine samples
statements.note: Isolation sources are given only for the six reference strains, not for d1418m22.

statements.text: Comparative analysis identified 20 antibiotic resistance genes, including ones for beta-lactams, fluoroquinolones and aminoglycosides.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: identified 20 antibiotic resistance genes, including those conferring resistance to beta-lactams, fluoroquinolones, and aminoglycosides
statements.note: The 20 resistance genes and drug classes are stated directly.

statements.text: The strain carried an SCCmec type V cassette.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: The presence of staphylococcal cassette chromosome mec ( SCCmec ) type IVa and mobile genetic elements (MGEs), such as prophages and transposons
statements.note: The SCCmec cassette was type IVa, not type V.

statements.text: The de novo assembly yielded 61 scaffolds spanning a 2.78 Mb genome.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: De novo assembly resulted in 61 scaffolds with a total genome size of 2.78 Mb
statements.note: The scaffold count and genome size are stated directly.

statements.text: Of 37 tumours, 36.8% of gastric and 44.4% of colorectal cancers were MSI-high.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: 36.8% of gastric and 44.4% of colorectal cancers were MSI-high
statements.note: The MSI-high percentages are stated directly.

statements.text: Patients with Lynch syndrome had worse overall survival than non-Lynch patients.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: These findings suggest that organ-specific selective pressures drive independent tumor evolution
statements.note: The study compares genomic overlap, not survival outcomes between the groups.

statements.text: The share of somatic mutations shared between a patient's paired tumours stayed below 5%.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: the proportion of overlapping somatic mutations between paired tumors was consistently low (< 5%)
statements.note: The under-5% overlap between paired tumours is stated directly.

statements.text: Germline pathogenic mismatch repair variants were found in all nineteen patients.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: Germline pathogenic MMR variants were identified in seven patients
statements.note: Germline pathogenic MMR variants were found in seven patients, not all nineteen.

statements.text: The nivolumab-plus-capecitabine arm raised peripheral immunoscore in 91% of patients by week 6, versus 47% and 53% for the single agents.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: combination of nivolumab plus capecitabine leads to a greater increase in PIS from baseline to week 6 (91%) compared with nivolumab (47%) or capecitabine (53%) alone (log-rank p = 0.08)
statements.note: The 91% versus 47% and 53% PIS increases are stated directly.

statements.text: The combination arm failed to meet the pre-specified primary endpoint.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: meeting the pre-specified primary endpoint
statements.note: The combination met, rather than failed to meet, the primary endpoint.

statements.text: The combination arm produced longer overall survival than the single-agent arms.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: Secondary endpoints include the presence of ctDNA, toxicity, clinical outcomes at 2-years and association of ctDNA and PIS with clinical outcomes
statements.note: Two-year outcomes were a secondary endpoint, but no survival comparison between arms is reported.

statements.text: The presence of circulating tumor DNA was associated with disease recurrence.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: the presence of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) was associated with disease recurrence
statements.note: The ctDNA-recurrence association is stated directly.

statements.text: The IS26 clusters were tested in clinical Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: recombinant E. coli strains carrying various genetic combinations from each cluster were subjected to antimicrobial susceptibility testing
statements.note: Testing used recombinant E. coli; no clinical isolate of another species was examined.

statements.text: Adding mrx to mph(A) raised azithromycin resistance by at least 48-fold.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: inclusion of mrx increased resistance by at least 48-fold
statements.note: The at-least-48-fold increase from adding mrx is stated directly.

statements.text: Disrupting both cysH and eamA together removed the extra tetracycline resistance, though knocking out either one alone did not.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Disruption of either cysH or eamA had no effect on this enhancement, but disruption of both genes eliminated it entirely
statements.note: The single versus double knockout effect is stated directly.

statements.text: In the absence of mph(A), mrx on its own substantially increased azithromycin resistance.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: In the absence of mph(A), mrx had no effect on azithromycin resistance
statements.note: Without mph(A), mrx had no effect on azithromycin resistance.

statements.text: PANX1 expression was downregulated in invasive melanoma cell lines.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: PANX1 expression is upregulated in invasive melanoma cell lines and is associated with increased YAP protein levels
statements.note: PANX1 was upregulated, not downregulated, in invasive melanoma cell lines.

statements.text: In TCGA data PANX1 mRNA correlated positively with YAP, TAZ and IQGAP1 in invasive melanoma and breast carcinoma.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: a significant positive correlation between PANX1 mRNA and core Hippo components, YAP, TAZ, and Hippo scaffold, IQGAP1, in invasive cutaneous melanoma and breast carcinoma
statements.note: The positive correlation in both cancer types is stated directly.

statements.text: PANX1 inhibition reduced melanoma tumour growth in mice.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: our investigation delves into the intricate interplay between PANX1 and YAP in the context of invasive melanoma, offering valuable insights into potential therapeutic strategies for effective treatment
statements.note: All functional work is in cell lines; no animal tumour-growth experiment is described.

statements.text: Knockdown or pharmacological inhibition of PANX1 lowered YAP protein levels in melanoma cells.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: pharmacological inhibition of PANX1 using selective FDA-approved inhibitors or PANX1 knockdown reduced YAP abundance in melanoma cells
statements.note: Both approaches reduced YAP abundance, as stated directly.

statements.text: Under the etiological standard, cfDNA-assisted AFS reached an AUC of 0.946, above AFS alone (0.808) and cfDNA alone (0.874).
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: higher AUCs (0.946 vs. 0.808 for AFS and 0.874 for cfDNA under etiological reference standard
statements.note: These AUC values under the etiological standard are stated directly.

statements.text: cfDNA-assisted AFS also identified the drug-resistance profile of the tuberculosis strains.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: CfDNA-assisted AFS enhances the diagnostic performance for PTB, providing a novel auxiliary tool for the clinical diagnosis of PTB
statements.note: The study assessed diagnostic accuracy only, not drug-resistance detection.

statements.text: Combining cfDNA with acid-fast staining lowered diagnostic performance compared with either test alone.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: cfDNA-assisted AFS exhibited superior diagnostic performance over either test alone
statements.note: The combination was superior to either test alone, not worse.

statements.text: cfDNA alone had a higher true-positive detection rate for PTB than acid-fast staining.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: the true-positive detection rate for PTB of cfDNA was higher than that of AFS (79.05% vs. 65.87% and 68.72% vs. 55.38%, respectively)
statements.note: cfDNA's higher true-positive rate over AFS is stated directly.

statements.text: BLITSFR requires uploading data to a centralised web service to run.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: The report opens in any modern browser, requiring no server or data upload
statements.note: BLITSFR's report needs no server or data upload, contradicting this statement.

statements.text: BLITSFR can process hundreds of genomes in minutes on a standard laptop.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: processes hundreds of genomes in minutes on a standard laptop
statements.note: This throughput claim is stated directly.

statements.text: BLITSFR aligns genomes faster than Mauve on the same datasets.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: existing tools often produce static visualisations or necessitate centralised web services and data uploads
statements.note: The abstract contrasts BLITSFR with existing tools generally but reports no head-to-head speed benchmark.

statements.text: BLITSFR was used on vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium ST78 genomes to confirm conservation of Tn1549-like transposons.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium ST78 genomes to confirm the conservation of Tn1549-like transposons
statements.note: This application is stated directly.

statements.text: The methylated ctDNA assay predicted lymph node involvement poorly, with AUCs of 52% and 57% across the two cohorts.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: ROC analyses of meth-ctDNA (negative/positive) to predict pN+ had an area under the curve of 52% and 57% in the discovery and validation cohort, respectively
statements.note: The near-chance AUCs are stated directly.

statements.text: The preoperative methylated ctDNA assay accurately predicted pathological lymph node involvement.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: The preoperative meth-ctDNA multiplex assay did not predict pN+
statements.note: The assay did not predict pN+, contradicting this statement.

statements.text: Methylated-ctDNA-positive patients received neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: The findings suggest meth-ctDNA as a more powerful marker than N-category in identifying high-risk patients who would potentially benefit from NAC
statements.note: NAC benefit is proposed; no patient is reported to have received NAC.

statements.text: Methylated-ctDNA-negative patients had better 48-month disease-free survival than positive patients.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: a higher rate of 48 months disease-free survival in meth-ctDNA negative compared to positive patients (HR=2.31, 95% CI 1.01-5.2)
statements.note: The survival difference by meth-ctDNA status is stated directly.

statements.text: The framework was evaluated on 90 stage I colorectal cancer patients.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: evaluate it on 90 stage III colorectal cancer patients with three years of follow-up
statements.note: The 90 patients had stage III, not stage I, colorectal cancer.

statements.text: Combining fragment length and end-motif features gave an AUC of 0.871, above the 0.832 for tumour-fraction estimates.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: 0.871 when combined, outperforming tumor fraction estimates based on the frequency of mutated fragments (AUC=0.832)
statements.note: The combined AUC of 0.871 versus 0.832 is stated directly.

statements.text: The approach detected relapse earlier than CT imaging in these patients.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: provides a scalable, training-free strategy for MRD assessment and early relapse detection
statements.note: Early relapse detection is claimed as a use-case, but no comparison to imaging timing is reported.

statements.text: Cancer-derived cfDNA showed fragment shortening with enrichment of A/T end motifs and depletion of C/G ends.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: fragment shortening, motif enrichment of A/T ends, and depletion of C/G ends
statements.note: These ctDNA-specific fragment patterns are stated directly.

statements.text: Early intervention guided by the model reduced the incidence of gestational diabetes.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: potentially enabling early interventions to prevent GDM development and associated complications
statements.note: Intervention benefit is hypothetical; no intervention trial is reported.

statements.text: The combined master score reached AUCs of about 86.8 to 87.2 with 70% sensitivity and 89% specificity.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: achieved AUCs of 86.82 - 87.19 across validation cohorts with 70% sensitivity and 89% specificity
statements.note: The master score's AUC range and operating point are stated directly.

statements.text: The framework was designed to predict gestational diabetes at 24 to 28 weeks of gestation.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: early GDM prediction at 10-12 weeks of gestation in Vietnamese women
statements.note: The framework predicts GDM at 10-12 weeks, not 24-28 weeks.

statements.text: The study analysed 1,086 pregnant women, 435 with GDM and 651 controls.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: 1,086 pregnant women (435 GDM cases, 651 controls)
statements.note: The cohort breakdown is stated directly.

statements.text: Strand-tagging cut sequencing error more than 10,000-fold and removed artefactual mutational signatures.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: duplex sequencing reduces sequencing error by >10,000-fold while eliminating artifactual mutational signatures
statements.note: The >10,000-fold error reduction is stated directly.

statements.text: Somatic mutation burden was higher in autism spectrum disorder brains than in neurotypical brains.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: clonal sSNVs that correlated with changes in expression of nearby genes, in both neurotypical and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) individuals
statements.note: Both groups were studied, but no between-group difference in mutation burden is reported.

statements.text: In a 98%/2% cell-line mix the method detected sSNVs present in 2% of cells with 92% precision.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Duplex-Multiome identified sSNVs present in 2% of cells with 92% precision
statements.note: The 2%-of-cells detection at 92% precision is stated directly.

statements.text: Across brain cell types, neuronal and glial cells showed essentially identical rates of age-related mutation.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: diverse neuronal and glial cell types show distinct rates and patterns of age-related mutation
statements.note: The cell types showed distinct, not identical, rates of age-related mutation.

statements.text: High P3H1 expression was associated with improved overall survival across the analysed tumours.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: high P3H1 expression is significantly associated with low overall survival
statements.note: High P3H1 expression was associated with low (worse) survival, not improved survival.

statements.text: P3H1 expression correlated significantly with sensitivity to nine drugs.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: A significant correlation was found between P3H1 expression and sensitivity to nine drugs
statements.note: The correlation with nine drugs is stated directly.

statements.text: Knockdown of P3H1 reduced proliferation in liver cancer cell lines.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: provides a theoretical basis for further in-depth studies to follow
statements.note: The analysis is entirely database-driven; no cell-line knockdown was performed.

statements.text: P3H1 DNA methylation was inversely correlated with its expression.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: A negative correlation was observed between P3H1 DNA methylation and its expression
statements.note: The negative methylation-expression correlation is stated directly.

statements.text: The centenarian SIRT6 variants raised SIRT6 protein levels by weakening its interaction with vimentin.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: the centenarian variants endogenously elevated SIRT6 protein levels through weakened interaction with vimentin
statements.note: The mechanism raising SIRT6 protein is stated directly.

statements.text: The variants enhanced SIRT6 deacetylase activity and reduced its mono-ADP-ribosyl transferase activity.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: enhanced mono-ADP-ribosyl transferase activity and reduced deacetylase activity
statements.note: The variants enhanced transferase and reduced deacetylase activity, the reverse of this statement.

statements.text: Carriers of the SIRT6 variants lived longer than non-carrier centenarians.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: two linked missense variants in SIRT6 that are enriched in Ashkenazi Jewish centenarians
statements.note: Enrichment in centenarians is noted, but no survival comparison between carriers and non-carriers is reported.

statements.text: The variants delayed senescence and suppressed transposable-element derepression while maintaining DNA repair.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: delayed replicative and progerin-induced cellular senescence, preserving genome stability through maintenance of DNA repair pathways and suppression of transposable element derepression
statements.note: These effects of the variants are stated directly.

statements.text: The classifiers predicted patient response to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: Elastic-net classifiers accurately identify causal MMR genes in Lynch tumors and uncover common occurrences of intermediate MMRd states
statements.note: The classifiers identify causal genes; no immunotherapy response prediction is reported.

statements.text: The study built 72 isogenic lineages representing 58 distinct genotypes.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Across 72 isogenic lineages representing 58 genotypes
statements.note: The lineage and genotype counts are stated directly.

statements.text: A dedicated short-tandem-repeat spectrum showed genome-wide evidence for MSH3-driven EMAST.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: A dedicated STR spectrum reveals genome-wide evidence for MSH3-driven EMAST
statements.note: The MSH3-driven EMAST finding is stated directly.

statements.text: MMR loss suppressed MUTYH-associated oxidative mutagenesis in the pairwise perturbations.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: including enhancement of MUTYH-associated oxidative mutagenesis by MMR loss
statements.note: MMR loss enhanced, not suppressed, MUTYH-associated oxidative mutagenesis.

statements.text: PiggyBac elements were found in 137 of 287 hymenopteran genomes, nearly half.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: PB elements detected in nearly half (137/287) of the genomes examined
statements.note: The 137/287 detection rate is stated directly.

statements.text: hcPB integrates with lower off-target frequency than the Sleeping Beauty transposon.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: These findings significantly advance the genome engineering toolkit, providing highly efficient tools with great promise for basic research and therapeutic applications
statements.note: No off-target analysis or comparison to another transposon system such as Sleeping Beauty is reported.

statements.text: Phylogenetic analysis grouped the hymenopteran PB transposases into a single clade.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: Phylogenetic reconstruction identified four distinct clades
statements.note: The transposases fell into four distinct clades, not a single one.

statements.text: hcPB and mePB were highly active, comparable to the engineered hyperactive hyPB, whereas adPB was minimally active.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: hcPB and mePB possess remarkable activity, comparable to the engineered hyperactive hyPB transposase. In contrast, adPB exhibited minimal transposition activity
statements.note: The activity levels of the three transposases are stated directly.

statements.text: Union calls supported by at least one caller produced the highest precision.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: union calls supported by at least 1 caller showed the highest recall (>0.88)
statements.note: Union calls gave the highest recall; the highest precision came from intersection calls.

statements.text: SaVor was tested on 1,165 Arabidopsis thaliana whole genomes.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: We tested SaVor on 1,165 Arabidopsis thaliana whole genome sequences
statements.note: The test set size is stated directly.

statements.text: SaVor detected more transposable-element insertions than Lumpy on the Arabidopsis genomes.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: benchmarked its performance on a set of SVs derived from the same accessions using Lumpy
statements.note: Lumpy was the benchmark reference, but no TE-insertion-specific count comparison is reported.

statements.text: Intersection calls, those supported by three SV callers, achieved the highest precision, above 0.91.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Intersection calls i.e. SVs supported by 3 SV callers showed the highest precision (>0.91)
statements.note: The highest precision for three-caller intersection calls is stated directly.

statements.text: Gret1-eliminated cells were detected in 19 of 45 transgenic plants.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: detected Gret1 eliminated cells in 19 of 45 transgenic plants
statements.note: The 19-of-45 figure is stated directly.

statements.text: In grape, the Gret1 insertion in the VvMYBA1a promoter activates VvMYBA1 expression.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: presence of the Gret1 retrotransposon in the promoter region of the VvMYBA1a allele at the VvMYBA1 locus suppress the expression of the VvMYBA1 transcription factor gene
statements.note: The Gret1 insertion suppresses, rather than activates, VvMYBA1 expression.

statements.text: The same CRISPR approach removed Gret1 from other grape cultivars beyond Shine Muscat.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: this transposon insertion is responsible for the green berry skin color of Vitis labrascana, 'Shine Muscat', a major grape cultivar in Japan
statements.note: Only the Shine Muscat VvMYBA1a case was targeted; generalisation to other cultivars is not examined.

statements.text: Cutting the long terminal repeats flanking Gret1 efficiently removed the transposon.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: cleaving the long terminal repeat (LTR) present at both ends of Gret1 can efficiently eliminate the transposon
statements.note: LTR cleavage efficiently eliminating Gret1 is stated directly.

statements.text: evDNA concentration predicted overall survival in stage IV colorectal cancer patients.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: Among Stage III patients, those with higher concentrations of evDNA had significantly poorer relapse-free survival compared with those who had lower concentrations of evDNA (p = 0.043)
statements.note: The survival link is relapse-free survival in stage III; no overall-survival analysis in stage IV is reported.

statements.text: evDNA detected KRAS mutations in 13.8% of patients whose tumour tissue had none.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: evDNA identified KRAS mutations in 13.8% of patients who lacked them in tumor tissue samples
statements.note: The 13.8% figure is stated directly.

statements.text: In stage III patients, evDNA detected KRAS mutations more often than ctDNA (43.1% vs 13.6%).
statements.label: supported
statements.note: The higher stage III sensitivity for evDNA is stated directly.

statements.text: In stage II and III patients, ctDNA was more sensitive than evDNA for detecting KRAS mutations.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: sensitivities to detect KRAS mutations using evDNA were higher than those using ctDNA
statements.note: evDNA was more sensitive than ctDNA, the reverse of this statement.

statements.text: In the training set the model predicted blood volume with Pearson r = 0.97 and an RMSE of 5.1 microlitres.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: the linear regression model showed a strong correlation between actual and predicted blood volume (Pearson r = 0.97, RMSE = 5.1 µL)
statements.note: The training-set correlation and RMSE are stated directly.

statements.text: The psDBS method detected circulating tumour DNA mutations in the cancer patients.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: DNA from psDBS was extracted, then quantified using a quantitative PCR assay targeting L1PA2
statements.note: The assay quantified total DNA concentration; no tumour-specific mutation detection is reported.

statements.text: DNA from the dried blood spots was quantified using a qPCR assay targeting KRAS.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: quantified using a quantitative PCR assay targeting L1PA2
statements.note: The qPCR assay targeted L1PA2, not KRAS.

statements.text: Plasma DNA concentration from psDBS correlated moderately with matched blood tubes (Spearman rho = 0.62).
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: Plasma DNA concentration in psDBS was moderately correlated with matched blood tubes (Spearman rho = 0.62)
statements.note: The moderate correlation with blood tubes is stated directly.

statements.text: Across 98 AD loci the analysis found 280 independent haplotypes, 207 of which (74%) carried linked structural variants.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: identified 280 independent AD-haplotypes, of which 207 (74%) harbored linked structural variants
statements.note: These haplotype and SV counts are stated directly.

statements.text: The PLEC regulatory tandem repeat was shown to increase Alzheimer's disease risk in carriers.
statements.label: not_addressed
statements.evidence: a CpG-rich tandem repeat associated with enhancer methylation and reduced microglial expression
statements.note: The repeat is tied to methylation and expression changes, but its own effect on AD risk is not quantified.

statements.text: Lead-SNP-only models were favoured at only 10% of loci, with multi-haplotype or SV models favoured at the other 90%.
statements.label: supported
statements.evidence: lead-SNP-only models were favored at just 10% of loci, whereas models incorporating multiple haplotypes, SVs, or both were favored at the remaining 90%
statements.note: The 10% versus 90% model comparison is stated directly.

statements.text: Only 10% of the haplotype-linked structural variants could be imputed into SNP-genotyped cohorts.
statements.label: contradicted
statements.evidence: we imputed 83% of haplotype-linked SVs into SNP-genotyped cohorts (median imputation R2 = 0.76)
statements.note: 83% of haplotype-linked SVs were imputed, not 10%.
